extension.summary: Browse and stream FORMED with your own subscription
extension.description:
Unofficial client for FORMED (formed.org).
Signs in with your own FORMED account using the service's standard OpenID Connect device flow, then browses the catalogue and streams content.
Playback only - this add-on does not download or record. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by FORMED or the Augustine Institute.
extension.news: 0.2.5 - Confirmed against FORMED's own web bundle that the add-on calls the same playback endpoint the website does, so nothing here is out of date. Found FORMED's /api/vimeo/health-check - the same signal that drives the "we are facing some issues with some of our videos" banner on their site - and the add-on now consults it when playback fails, so a FORMED outage says so instead of looking like a local fault. Embed request now matches the web player's exactly (adds auto=1). 0.2.4 - Playback 503s. The failure is in Vimeo OTT's edge (embed.vhx.tv), which returns a Fastly error page in streaks lasting minutes and never reaches the origin. Ruled out: the account, subscription, ticket, request headers, Fastly node and IP version. The add-on cannot prevent it, so it now fails in about two seconds instead of hanging, says plainly that the fault is not yours, and reports it as a notification rather than a modal dialog so pressing play again is one button. 0.2.3 - Fix a blank settings screen: Kodi reads setting labels as string ids, so the literal English text in settings.xml rendered every row empty and left no way to reach sign-in. Labels now come from a proper strings.po. Transient HTTP 503s from FORMED are retried with backoff instead of killing a whole menu, connections are pooled (menus draw ~40% faster), and the top-level nav is cached so browsing survives an outage. 0.2.2 - Hide menus with no video in them, Books included. 0.2.1 - Stop duplicating subtitles. External tracks are attached only when the manifest has none of its own, so no more "Unknown (External)" copies. Added a subtitle language setting, defaulting to English. 0.2.0 - Sign-in moved to Settings. Device code now shown in its own readable dialog. Video-only listings. Single-season shows go straight to episodes. Search works via /api/search. Added icon and fanart. 0.1.5 - Seeking root cause: InputStream Adaptive was not installed and optional deps fail silently. ISA is now required, plus a clear warning if it is missing. Drop deprecated ResumeTime/TotalTime properties. 0.1.4 - Resume points read from FORMED. Subtitle tracks. Seeking fix: prefer the H.264-only stream and send headers on segment requests. 0.1.3 - Add the missing hop: embed page carries OTTData.config_url, not the manifest. Fetch the config (single-use) and pull HLS from it. Confirmed no DRM - mediaKeys is null with EME available. 0.1.2 - Playback ticket found. It belongs to the account, not the video: /api/users/me/subscriber -> subscriber.vimeoAuthTicket. 0.1.1 - Fix empty browse menu: nav-links is nested dicts with string leaves, not a list of objects. Pin Kids to the root. 0.1.0 - Initial build. Device-code sign-in, catalogue browsing, HLS playback.
